scope: Package-library and part top-level accessors consumed by unchanged AOT on host ARM64
observations: The package getter and setter, split across package:piece/piece.dart and its part, install as separate helpers under the owning library.
Application and package callers remain in baseline AOT; shared storage and the baseline AOT binary are unchanged.
Archived baseline and patch package sources compile independently to ordinary AOT and match mixed-run output exactly: first:1:1/after:3:3 and first:11:11/after:36:36.
The unified native report also rechecks existing accessor metadata and metadata-only relinking under the same compiler fingerprint.
not_accepted: Full M1 language/runtime compatibility and the historical native suite were not rerun.
Android/iOS physical-device execution, Flutter cold-start activation, signing, rollback and performance gates remain unverified.
Cross-language-version accessors and accessor signature/layout changes require separate validation.
